lessons: In tests/integration/test_regress_scripts_guarded.py, assert that the line `if __name__ == "__main__":` appears in the text of every script matched by the glob of tests/regress_*.py. Add no skip for scripts that import clutch.__main__. Review found that the skip let

Redo all ten scripts from the merge base. Put the reproducer in `def main() -> None:` and end each file with `if __name__ == "__main__": main()`. Keep constants, imports and helpers at module level. Review found this approach sound.

In tests/regress_requisition_prior_review.py and tests/regress_review_intakes_own_stem.py, import clutch's entry point as `from clutch.__main__ import main as clutch_main` and call clutch_main. That way the new local main() does not shadow it. Review accepted this alias fix.

The test must glob tests/regress_*.py, never list the ten files by name. For each module, import it with stdout captured and assert empty stdout and no SystemExit. Run tests/regress_premise_park_keep.py as a subprocess and assert one line, {"regression_result": "pass"}, and exit code 0.

Before you finish, delete the guard line from one of the two clutch_main files and confirm the test fails. This checks that the text check covers those files. Then run ./dev.py test tests/integration/test_regress_scripts_guarded.py.
